asks: What is the shape of Silo?
answer: One long-lived computer, main, where your agents work. The record of everything that happens in it. This is the core of the product. Going back: checkpoints, taken on their own, that you can restore or fork from. Forks for the moments that call for one: a risky try, a tool to test before trusting it. A fresh computer serves a task that must run on a clean machine.
